about_the_game:
Have you already met Little Sam, from whom you can take over the used car dealership in Car Dealer Simulator? His wife, Clever Emma, runs a small car wash right next door. Wouldn't it be nice to expand it and become the biggest and best car wash in Wingston Springs?

Start with a simple manual car wash for passenger cars and a vacuum for interior upholstery…



… and then expand your services with more car washing and cleaning options.

Your task will be to provide the best possible service for incoming vehicles, focusing on both speed and quality of service.

The game combines elements of management, work organization, and simulation. You won’t just be washing cars - you’ll also take care of the entire infrastructure, from keeping the car wash clean and regularly servicing the machines to investing in new technologies that will attract more customers.

Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your services from passenger cars to delivery vehicles or even larger machines that require a specialized approach.

Car Cleaner Simulator is fun not only for fans of business-themed simulators but also for those seeking a relaxing and satisfying experience. The game allows you to create your ideal car wash, where the quality of services, efficiency, and the wealth of your business depend entirely on your skills and strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/10/11 64-bit
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: In Car Cleaner Simulator, build your dream cleaning business - solo or in co-op! Tackle the challenge of detailing vehicles inside and out, gaining new skills and tools to satisfy even the most demanding customers.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support
